notes_pt: Logic: volta a abrir a sessão direto em todas as versões. No Logic 11, se aparecer "The file couldn't be opened.", o app mostra como importar (File > Import > Final Cut Pro XML).
notes_en: Logic: the session opens directly again in every version. In Logic 11, if you see "The file couldn't be opened.", the app shows how to import it (File > Import > Final Cut Pro XML).
